vedic_reference.note: Jaideep is a popular name in Hindu mythology, especially for males. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'जय' (Jaya) meaning 'victory' and 'दीप' (Dip) meaning 'deep'. The name is believed to bring victory and success in life. It is also associated with Lord Rama, who is known as 'जयदीप' (Jayadeep) or 'जय (Jaya) - victorious, दीप (Deep) - light, जयदीप (Jayadeep) - giver of victory'.
